englishText: She will bear a son, and you shall call his name Jesus, for he will save his people from their sins.
originalText: τέξεται δὲ υἱὸν καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν· αὐτὸς γὰρ σώσει τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν.

tokens.morphology: verb, future middle indicative, third singular
tokens.quickExplanation: The future verb points to the promised birth announced by the angel.
The promised child is identified before His saving name and mission are explained.

tokens.morphology: verb, future active indicative, second singular
tokens.quickExplanation: Joseph is commanded to name the child, publicly receiving Him into David's legal line.
The name carries the saving mission explained in the rest of the verse.

tokens.morphology: verb, future active indicative, third singular
tokens.quickExplanation: Matthew defines Jesus' mission as rescue from sin, not merely moral advice.
The saving mission gathers a people who belong to Him.
The plural names the problem Jesus comes to deal with: real sins before God.
